title: How To Setup Sidebars For Post Types | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Setup Sidebars For Post Types Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000681822 Essentially every Post Type has two main pages, the search results page where all the results for that feature show up: And the details page where the details of every single post from that feature show up.: An example of a feature search result page can be seen on the link down below: The Jobs Feature Search Result Page An example of a feature detail page can be seen on the link down below: The Job Feature Post Details Page Our software will allow users to add/remove/edit specific sidebars to each of these pages specified. How to Add/Remove Widgets From the Sidebars Before we can add or remove any widgets from these sidebars, first we have to identify which Sidebars that we will be making these edits on. How to Identify Which Sidebar to Edit To identify which Post Type using which sidebar on which page, navigate to Content >> Edit Post Settings >> Click " Edit " on preferred Post Type: In its edit view, Search Results Design and Detail Page Design are the tabs we will be using: When on the Search Results Design tab, scroll down and identify the sidebar under Sidebar To Use section: When on the Detail Page Design tab, scroll down and identify the sidebar under Sidebar To Use section: Another way to identify which sidebar is being used on what page is to utilize the Admin Bar tool on the front end and click on the Show Widgets button: Not only will this display the names of the widgets being used on the page but it will also display the sidebars being used on the page: Important Note Post Type sidebars come with a set of pre-defined filters and fields, which can’t be expanded through the standard settings. To add custom filter types to post type sidebars, this would require a customization.
